career_history: Estimating Manager at Kiewit, 3/2026 to present; Lead Estimator at Kiewit, 9/2025 to 3/2026; Estimator at Kiewit, 2/2024 to 9/2025; Estimator at Turner Construction, 8/2022 to 2/2024; Associate Estimator at Chesapeake Contracting Group, 8/2021 to 8/2022; Estimator at Osborne Construction, 11/2020 to 8/2021; Field Engineer at Turner Construction, 6/2020 to 11/2020; Project Engineer Intern at STRUCTURAL, 5/2019 to 8/2019; Project Engineer Intern at STRUCTURAL, 7/2018 to 8/2018; Project Manager Intern at CPI Foundation, 2/2018 to 4/2018; First-Line Supervisor at US Army, 8/2014 to 3/2018; First-Line Supervisor at US Army, 1/2011 to 7/2014; Team Lead at US Army, 5/2007 to 12/2010

biography: Construction Manager & Estimator with a Master’s in Construction Management and over 5 years of experience supporting preconstruction and field operations across Retail, Multi-Family Housing, Senior Living, Industrial, Automotive, Data Center, and Federal projects in the Mid-Atlantic region. I specialize in competitive and negotiated bids, collaborative project planning, and value-driven estimating strategies. My leadership approach is grounded in 10 years of service in the U.S. Army, where I developed a strong foundation in mission-focused execution and accountability. I’ve contributed to complex federal projects for agencies such as the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Architect of the Capitol, often working within environments that require a high level of discretion and trust. In both field and preconstruction roles, I’ve leveraged tools like Procore and Bluebeam to improve collaboration, drive efficiency, and support project teams from concept through closeout. I’m especially interested in how technology continues to transform construction delivery in the public sector.
